title: John Mills sees zigzagging object near Malmstrom
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Mills sees zigzagging object near Malmstrom, about January 1993 at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

>> And then I believe um, in 1993, there's a a now retired missile technician, a guy named John Mills,

tellings.link_reason: Both are about retired missile technician John Mills seeing a UFO near Malmstrom in 1993.

as_told.title: John Mills sees UFO; Malmstrom swarmed

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in January 1993 John Mills, a member of a missile targeting team at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that looks after nuclear missiles, was driving back to base with a crew of six. According to Michels, Mills recalls seeing a bright object zigzagging around the sky, and in another telling Michels says the base was swarmed with objects. He tells it as part of a pattern of unexplained objects watching nuclear sites.
